persona: Calm and helpful. Took one photo that night in the rain and it came out blurry; has not taken another yet.
initial_message: Hello, I need to make a claim. On Thursday night (the 24th) at about half past nine I was turning into my driveway in heavy rain and clipped the concrete letterbox pillar with the passenger side of my car. The front left door and the guard are dented and scraped. Nobody was hurt and the car is fine to drive.

The frame shows only the front door, the front guard and the letterbox pillar. No text, no logos, no people.

design.notes: The only damage photo is blurred and no clear photo exists yet. The current policy period started on 1 September 2026, 23 days before the incident, but that is a renewal: the policy was first taken out on 1 September 2019.

triage.rationale: The only damage photo is too blurred to show the damage, and the claimant has not taken another, so a readable incident image is outstanding. Otherwise fast: single vehicle on the claimant's own driveway, nobody hurt, car drivable, a complete quote at NZD 1,880.25 including GST. The recent period start is a renewal, not a new policy. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 September 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2019-09-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear. The current period started 23 days before the incident, but that is a renewal date, not the inception.
